import copy,hashlib,json,pathlib,sys

Retain original pulse held support and omit the unselected kick. Whole-arrangement interest remains unaccepted.')

require(len(a)==len(b)==9006 and all(len(x)==len(y)==25 for x,y in zip(a,b)),'Complete frame coverage or bank width changed')
require(hashlib.sha256(reference_wav.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='27cfef0f6487a919881dacd6b697edcab843be866198f7512aeedabc2703ce57','Rebuilt reference must reproduce the exact submitted narrow-pulse full WAV')
ignored=set(('instrument','instrumentId','pattern','row','byteOffset'))
def schedule(manifest):
    return [[dict((k,v) for k,v in n.items() if k not in ignored) for n in voice['notes']] for voice in manifest['voices']]
require(schedule(ma)==schedule(mb),'Notes, source timing, native gate timing or formal roles changed')
require(all(ma[k]==mb[k] for k in ('stopTick','stopVolumeClearTick','clock','sidModel','sidCount','totalTicks','ticksPerSecond')),'Clock, chip or ending contract changed')
changed_notes=[]
for vi,(va,vb) in enumerate(zip(ma['voices'],mb['voices'])):
    for na,nb in zip(va['notes'],vb['notes']):
        target='upper-lead' if vi==0 and 236<=na['startBeat']<276 else na['instrumentId']

require(collections.Counter(n['toInstrument'] for n in changed_notes)==dict((('upper-lead',97),)),'Unexpected changed-role note coverage')

import hashlib,json,math,pathlib,sys
from audio_comparison import Pcm16,measure_pcm,read_pcm16
def require(condition,message):
    if not condition: raise ValueError(message)
reports=[]
for label,manifest_path,wav_path in zip(('reference','candidate'),sys.argv[1:3],sys.argv[3:5]):
    manifest_bytes=pathlib.Path(manifest_path).read_bytes()
    manifest=json.loads(manifest_bytes)
    stop_tick,rate=manifest['stopTick'],manifest['ticksPerSecond']
    require(type(stop_tick) is int and stop_tick>0 and type(rate) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(rate) and rate>0 and manifest['stopVolumeClearTick']==stop_tick,'Invalid native stop/volume-clear timing')
    stop=stop_tick/rate
    audio=read_pcm16(wav_path)
    first,last=(round((stop-offset)*audio.sample_rate) for offset in (0.5,0.1))
    require(audio.channels==manifest['sidCount'] and 0<=first<last<=audio.frames and last/audio.sample_rate<stop,'Pre-stop release window must fit the declared audio before volume clear')
    samples=audio.samples[first*audio.channels:last*audio.channels]
    metrics=measure_pcm(Pcm16(audio.sample_rate,audio.channels,last-first,samples,''))
    require(all(channel['acRms']<=16 for channel in metrics['perChannel']),label+' release exceeds 16 PCM16 AC RMS before volume clear')
    if sys.byteorder!='little': samples.byteswap()
    reports.append(dict(label=label,manifestSha256=hashlib.sha256(manifest_bytes).hexdigest(),audioSha256=audio.sha256,stopTick=stop_tick,stopVolumeClearTick=manifest['stopVolumeClearTick'],ticksPerSecond=rate,stopSeconds=stop,requestedWindowSeconds=[stop-0.5,stop-0.1],window=dict(startFrame=first,endFrame=last,startSeconds=first/audio.sample_rate,endSeconds=last/audio.sample_rate,pcm16LeSha256=hashlib.sha256(samples.tobytes()).hexdigest(),metrics=metrics)))
pathlib.Path(sys.argv[5]).write_text(json.dumps(dict(schemaVersion=1,maxPerChannelAcRms=16,scope='Rendered decay must settle in the declared window before native volume clear; musical ending acceptance remains open.',renders=reports),indent=2)+chr(10))

import hashlib,json,math,pathlib,sys
from audio_comparison import read_pcm16

def require(condition,message):
    if not condition:raise ValueError(message)

a,b=map(read_pcm16,sys.argv[1:3])
require((a.sample_rate,a.channels,a.frames)==(b.sample_rate,b.channels,b.frames),'Full render formats and lengths differ')
reports=[]
for label,report_path in zip(('high-lead',),sys.argv[3:4]):
    report=json.loads(pathlib.Path(report_path).read_text())
    require(report['normalization'] is False and all(x['gain']==1 and x['gainDb']==0 for x in report['inputs']),'Both comparison sides must retain unity gain')
    require([x['sha256'] for x in report['inputs']]==[a.sha256,b.sha256],'Comparison must use these exact full renders in baseline/candidate order')
    first,last=(report['window'][key]*a.channels for key in ('startFrame','endFrame'))
    delta=[y-x for x,y in zip(a.samples[first:last],b.samples[first:last])]
    changed=sum(x!=0 for x in delta)
    require(changed>0,'The submitted role pair has no signal change')
    mean=sum(delta)/len(delta)
    rms=math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in delta)/len(delta))
    reports.append(dict(label=label,window=report['window'],changedSamples=changed,totalSamples=len(delta),deltaRms=rms,deltaAcRms=math.sqrt(max(0,rms*rms-mean*mean)),comparisonSha256=report['comparison']['sha256'],inputGains=[x['gain'] for x in report['inputs']]))
pathlib.Path(sys.argv[4]).write_text(json.dumps(dict(schemaVersion=1,referenceSha256=a.sha256,candidateSha256=b.sha256,comparisons=reports,scope='Confirms nonidentical PCM from the exact submitted unity-gain pair; this does not establish audibility, preference or musical usefulness.'),indent=2)+chr(10))
